answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 26595 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it ok for a girl who does sharai parda to get a hair style/hair cut like in layers ect. for her brothers wedding or to make her husband happy? 2)and is it true that if a girl gets her hair cut her dead body will weight heavier?. 3)and is it ok to get hair trimed 1 inch when hair starts damaging/double heads? Question: aoa is it ok for a girl who does sharai parda to get a hair style/hair cut like in layers ect. for her brothers wedding or to make her husband happy? 2)and is it true that if a girl gets her hair cut her dead body will weight heavier?. 3)and is it ok to get hair trimed 1 inch when hair starts damaging/double heads? Answer ID: 26595 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1548/1548/M=1431) (1) No, she cannot cut her hair. It is unlawful and sin. It is not lawful to do so to please one's husband too. قطعت شعر رأسها أتممت و لعنت زاد فى البزازية : و إن بإذن الزوج لا طاعة لمخلوق في معصية الخالق . (درمختار) (2) It is baseless saying. It has no proof in Shariah. (3) There is no harm in cutting the hair in small size to set the tip of hair and to protect it from harm. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
